title: Regulated-Scope Supplement Abatement Disposal — Insurance Claim Services Estimating Note
content:
Abatement disposal in an Insurance Claim Services regulated-scope supplement turns on three facts recorded on the Water Damage Mitigation job: the building's year built against the tier's asbestos sampling year cutoff, whether an asbestos sampling line was billed, and whether a debris haul was billed.

**Rule.** The abatement disposal is taken as follows: when the building was built before the water job tier's asbestos sampling year cutoff, the job billed an asbestos sampling line and the job billed a debris haul, the debris haul billed on the job; when the building was built before that cutoff, the job billed an asbestos sampling line and no debris haul, the dumpster billed on the job; otherwise no disposal line.

The asbestos sampling year cutoff is 1981 on every Water Damage Mitigation tier: a year built of 1980 or earlier is before it, 1981 or later is not. The lines are taken at the amount billed on the water job.

## Combinations

| Built 1980 or earlier | Asbestos sampling billed | Debris haul billed | Disposal taken |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | yes | the debris haul billed |
| yes | yes | no | the dumpster billed |
| yes | no | yes or no | none |
| no | any | any | none |

## Hypothetical illustration

A building built in 1966 whose water job billed asbestos sampling, a debris haul of 268.00 and a dumpster of 540.00 takes 268.00, the debris haul. With no debris haul billed it takes the 540.00 dumpster. Built in 1984, it takes no disposal line whatever was billed.
